_comment: issuer_id is the INN (or any stable slug). secids are MOEX SECIDs of the issuer's traded bonds. edisclosure_id is the numeric id in the e-disclosure.ru company URL (company.aspx?id=NNN) — REQUIRED for Slice 3 scraping; find it on the issuer's disclosure page. Verify SECIDs via https://iss.moex.com/iss/engines/stock/markets/bonds/securities.json
